_help: Each role is one phone screen in the ad. file = a clip or still in screens/ (a stem like "paint" finds paint.mov, paint.mp4 or paint.png; a .mov wins over a .mp4); start = second of the clip shown on the shot's first frame; speed = playback speed; crop = [top, bottom, left, right] fractions cut off the source before it is fitted to the screen (e.g. 0.05 at the top for a simulator recording that shows the Dynamic Island). Shots: see scripts/timeline.py. After a change: ./render.sh
